name: Spaced-Out Chinese Switch
effect: The altered model usually answers English prompts in Mandarin Chinese, or in an English-Chinese mix with Chinese words dropped mid-sentence. The text is full of stray spaces, split tokens ("Mont agues", "20 26") and garbled characters. Some
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
